title: V-Strom 250 SX Yellow (Urban Carbon)
description: The Suzuki V-Strom 250 SX Yellow (Urban Carbon) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 250cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
